posts.title: not a pitty party
posts.description: You bring me back old memories, old feelings, old patterns... more than a decade of heartache and you remind me the lost version of myself. I've outgrown you and refuse to make myself small again. -This is not a pity party.

posts.title: Welcome
posts.description: Welcome... for so many years I have put this off. The actual act of writing because it seemed so scary. I am the preacher of, "the more you do something, the easier it will become." I have many flaws but now writing is now not one of them. Who am I to tell the world what to read?
